entries.title: A task you move as it starts runs where you moved it
entries.body: If you changed where a waiting task runs just as it started, it could start on a model only your other computer is signed in to, keep waiting for that computer's GitHub sign-in, or say it was waiting for a computer with room. It now starts where you moved it, on a model that place is signed in to.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the task's crewmate starts on the computer it was moved to.
